name: stock-rest
description: Example REST API: it stands for a service you already run, with an OpenAPI contract and no GraphQL. Nothing of it is published: the stock-api adapter calls it on the platform's network. Its source is apis/stock-rest; build the image with: docker build -t ghcr.io/rudney5000/plugbricks/stock-rest:0.1.0 apis/stock-rest
